test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In February 2022, the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare launched the National Polio Immunisation Drive for 2022 for administering polio drops to children below ______ years of age.
solution:
The correct answer is **__five__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Immunisation Drive for Polio vaccine drops is being conducted from 19th June 2022.
 
• Around 3.9 crore children, less than five years are given Polio drops through booths, house to house, mobile, and transit teams.
 
• To provide additional protection to children, the Government of India has introduced the injectable inactivated Poliovirus vaccine.
 
• India was certified Polio-free on **27th March 2014**, in the South-East Asia region of WHO.
 
• The last case of polio was reported on 13th January 2011, from Howrah West Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Union Health Minister, Dr Mansukh Mandaviya launched the National Polio Immunization Drive.
 
• India conducts one nationwide NID and two Sub-National Immunization Day (SNIDs) for polio every year to maintain population immunity against wild poliovirus and to sustain its polio-free status
 
• Approximately 23.6 crore houses were visited by nearly 24 lakh volunteers and 1.5 lakh supervisors.
 
• The Universal Immunization Programme is focusing on protecting children from more diseases than ever before.
